thread:
matt (security): Auditor asked for mapping of recent RBAC changes to control IDs, KMS access logs export for 2024-04-01..2024-04-07, and a vuln-triage timeline for CVE-2024-1234.

oliver (compliance): looping in @janice from the audit team — can you confirm preferred delivery format?

janice (auditor): Hi team — CSV for RBAC mapping, newline-delimited JSON (jsonl) for KMS/CloudTrail events, and a short markdown timeline for vuln triage. Zipped bundle via secure drop is fine. Deadline EOD Thu. :pray:

matt (security): Plan: RBAC_change_log.csv, kms_access_events.jsonl, vuln-triage-timeline.md, manifest.csv (sha256s). Also include Splunk/CloudWatch query and retention config.

sophia (eng): Quick question — do you need envelope key usage events + CMK usage, or just Decrypt/GenerateDataKey?

matt (security): Include both. We should pull CloudTrail events for kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext and related S3 GETs where applicable. Use this example Splunk query for export:

```
index=cloudtrail eventName IN ("Decrypt", "GenerateDataKey", "GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext") resource=arn:aws:kms:*
| stats count by eventName, userIdentity.arn, awsRegion, eventTime
```

sophia (eng): For RBAC export I'll include rolebindings and service account changes since 2023-11-01. CSV columns: principal,type,binding,namespace,changed_by,change_ts,change_pr

maria (sec-ops): For vuln triage evidence: attaching PR list, CVE notes, mitigation PRs, and incident response checklist invoked. I'll produce a short narrative for timeline.

matt (security): Auditor requested chain-of-custody for each file — include manifest.csv with SHA256 and S3 path. Example manifest row:

```
file,sha256,s3_path
rbac_changes.csv,3b7f9d2a...,s3://redwood-compliance/audits/2024-04/rbac_changes.csv
```

sophia (eng): Who will stage/upload the bundle to the secure drop?

maria (sec-ops): I'll upload to the secure drop and add ACL private + 30d expiry. Leave files in s3://redwood-compliance/audits/2024-04/pending until upload.

janice (auditor): Also need written confirmation of log retention policy and a copy of the lifecycle policy — retention must be >= 1 year for control evidence. Redacted logs are ok.

matt (security): We retain CloudTrail + KMS events for 13 months in S3 and transition to Glacier after 90 days. I'll attach the bucket lifecycle snippet and the bucket policy.

sophia (eng): Example lifecycle snippet to include:

```
{
  "Rules": [{
    "ID": "cloudtrail-retention",
    "Status": "Enabled",
    "Expiration": {
      "Days": 395
    }
  }]
}
```

maria (sec-ops): We should remember to redact user emails and PII from exported events before upload. Janice: confirm redaction is acceptable?

janice (auditor): Yes redact sensitive PII; please document redaction steps in the manifest. Also include a short mapping doc that ties each RBAC change to SOC2/ISO control IDs (e.g., SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.9.2) — one-liner per change is fine.

matt (security): Will add control-mapping.md with bullet mappings and a one-paragraph justification per change.

sophia (eng): ETA: initial bundle ready by tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Will put all interim artifacts under s3://redwood-compliance/audits/2024-04/pending and tag with `audit:2024-04`.

maria (sec-ops): tagging @deploy-bot to trigger artifact snapshot job :robot_face:

deploy-bot: snapshot job 54321 queued by maria

matt (security): One more ask from auditor — proof of incident response involvement for the vuln (timeline + runbook steps executed). Maria, can you include runbook excerpts (redacted) + PR links?

maria (sec-ops): Yes — adding runbook extract and PR #s. I'll also attach the PagerDuty incident link and timeline (redacted user ids).

janice (auditor): Perfect. Please ensure manifest lists every file and sha256, and that RBAC CSV includes `changed_by` with internal username (redacted if external). Once we get the bundle I'll confirm completeness or request follow-ups by Friday. :thumbsup:

matt (security): Thanks all. Final ask: upload any outstanding artifacts to s3://redwood-compliance/audits/2024-04/pending by 10:00 UTC tomorrow so we can run the snapshot and deliver.

sophia (eng): Will do.

maria (sec-ops): Copy.

janice (auditor): Thanks — I'll look for the secure drop link.

matt (security): Link will be posted here once upload completes.
